title_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1 ne Zonen e ish-Bllokut
description_sq: Shitet apartament 2+1 ne Zonen e ish-Bllokut.Apartamenti ka siperfaqe neto 97 m² ne certifikate dhe pozicionohet ne katin e 3-te te nje pallati ekzistues buze rruges kryesore.Organizohet nga 2 dhoma gjumi,1 tualet,kuzhine me vete dhe soxhorno.Totalisht i restauruar ne detaje,mure,tavane gipesi,elektrike,hidraulike,dyer,dritare te reja blerja e ketij apartamenti eshte nje mundesi e mire banimi ne zemer te Tiranes me te gjitha facilitetet afer por edhe investimi duke qene se prona eshte e pershtatshme edhe per hoteleri,zyra,biznes,klinika etj.Cmimi 350.000 euro i negociueshem
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the area of ​​the former block
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in the area of the former block. The apartment has a net area of 97 m² in the certificate and is located on the 3rd floor of an existing building on the edge of the main road. It is organized by 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, separate kitchen and living room. Totally restored in detail, walls, plaster ceilings, electrical, hydraulic, new doors, windows, the purchase of this apartment is a good opportunity to live in the heart of Tirana with all facilities nearby, but also an investment, since the property is also suitable for hotels, offices, businesses, clinics, etc. The price is 350,000 euros, negotiable
